subject: BlueOak MAP kickoff — private deployment topology & security owners
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Hassan <samira.hassan@blueoak.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: BlueOak MAP kickoff — private deployment topology & security owners

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the productive evaluation sessions last week. As we discussed, I wanted to kick off a short MAP (mutual action plan) to align engineering owners and land the private/VPC deployment for BlueOak’s analytics platform. Goal is to get a shared timeline, confirm networking & IAM/KMS owners, and agree on the evaluation pass/fail criteria so we can hit a production-ready decision by the end of Q3.

Proposed items to cover on the kickoff call:
- Network topology: VPN vs. dedicated interconnect and expected IP/routing constraints
- IAM & KMS ownership: who will own keys; Redwood integrations (KMS/HSM)
- Deployment topology: number of nodes, expected peak traffic, region requirements
- Evaluation gates: perf SLOs, privacy/compliance checks, acceptance tests
- Timeline & responsibilities: milestones to production readiness

I've attached a first-draft network diagram and a suggested MAP timeline (spreadsheet). Can you confirm the BlueOak engineering contacts for networking and security? If the names below are correct, we can schedule a 60-minute kickoff this week:

Suggested BlueOak owners (from discovery):
- Networking: Nikhil Patel <n.patel@blueoak.com>
- Security/KMS: Samira Hassan <samira.hassan@blueoak.com>

Suggested Redwood attendees: Ben (networks), Marissa (devops/onprem lead), Vivek (customer success lead).

Proposed times (PST):
- Thu 13 May 10:00–11:00
- Thu 13 May 15:00–16:00
- Fri 14 May 09:00–10:00

Quick ask: can you confirm owners and pick a slot? Once we have that, Ben will share a short pre-read.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueOak MAP kickoff — private deployment topology & security owners

Jordan — thanks for putting this together. Confirming that Nikhil and I will be the primary owners on our side: Nikhil will lead network/VPN and routing, I’ll own security/KMS and compliance signoffs. Adding cloud-ops alias for any scheduling/hosting details.

We reviewed the draft timeline; two quick notes:
- For the VPN/interconnect decision, we need a short cost estimate for both options before we pick. Can Redwood provide ballpark throughput costs for the Dedicated vs. Hosted paths?
- KMS: BlueOak uses a centralized KMS (CloudKMS) and would like to evaluate Redwood’s integration with an external KMS and bring-your-own-key flow. We’ll need an HSM/KMS diagram for our security review.

I can do Thu 13 May 15:00–16:00 PST. Please send calendar invite and any pre-reads.

Samira Hassan
Head of Security, BlueOak Financial

Great — booked Thu 13 May 15:00–16:00 PST (calendar invite sent). Agenda + pre-read items below; I’ll share a short packet before the call (~10–15 mins to review).

Kickoff agenda (60m):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Review proposed topology diagram (15m)
   - VPN vs. interconnect pros/cons
   - Subnet plan & NAT/eBGP considerations
3) KMS integration options (15m)
   - BYOK flow, key rotation, access audit trails
4) Evaluation gates & acceptance tests (15m)
   - Perf SLO: 95th percentile token latency, throughput targets
   - Data residency & audit log sampling
5) Next steps / action owners (10m)

Pre-reads I’ll attach to the invite: network diagram (v1), Redwood KMS integration notes, MAP milestone spreadsheet. Can BlueOak ops share any existing eBGP requirements or IP ranges ahead of the call? That will help the topology discussion.

Action items assigned in advance:
- BlueOak: send eBGP/IP ranges + any firewall constraints (Nikhil)
- BlueOak security: brief on KMS policy (Samira)
- Redwood: provide initial throughput & cost delta for VPN vs interconnect (Ben)

Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueOak MAP kickoff — private deployment topology & security owners

Thanks everyone for the quick confirmations and the productive call today. Summary and next steps below (keeping the MAP action items tight so we can move to evaluation quickly).

Call recap (short):
- Network: BlueOak prefers VPN initial proof-of-concept to validate routing and firewall behavior; interconnect discussed as path to production if throughput/costs justify it.
- KMS: BlueOak will validate Redwood’s BYOK flow with CloudKMS; Redwood to provide HSM integration diagram and a short checklist for SOC2 evidence required.
- Topology: agreed to a 3-node private cluster in us-west-2 for initial eval, with autoscale for burst capacity.

Committed next steps (owners & dates):
- Nikhil (BlueOak) — provide IP ranges and firewall rules by Mon 17 May EOD.
- Samira (BlueOak) — share KMS policy doc and any compliance checklists by Tue 18 May.
- Ben (Redwood) — deliver VPN vs interconnect throughput estimate & cost delta by Tue 18 May.
- Marissa (Redwood) — share deployment runbook and acceptance-test checklist by Wed 19 May.
- Jordan (Redwood) — update MAP spreadsheet with these milestones and circulate by Wed 19 May.

Acceptance criteria (initial eval):
- Functional: model endpoints reachable inside VPC; sample workload runs at target throughput (X tokens/sec) with < 150ms 95th token latency.
- Security: BYOK validation completed; audit logs accessible to BlueOak SOC.
- Ops: documented rollback & escalation plan.

I'll upload the updated MAP & runbook to the Drive link and flag the items we agreed. If there are any objections to the dates above, call them out now — otherwise I’ll proceed to assign tasks in the MAP and send the first status check on Mon 24 May.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Principal DevOps | Redwood Inference
